title: GitLab CVSS 10.0 Integer Overflow issue
title_zh: GitLab CVSS 10.0 整数溢出漏洞

paragraphs.en: On October 21, 2026, we released versions 19.5.1, 19.4.3, 19.3.6, 19.2.9, 19.1.9, 19.0.10, 18.11.13 for GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE).

These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to one of these versions immediately. GitLab.com is already running the patched version. GitLab Dedicated tenants running 19.3.5-internal0 and 19.4.2-internal0 or later already include these fixes and do not need to take action.
paragraphs.zh: 这些版本包含重要的错误修复和安全修复，我们强烈建议所有自管理的 GitLab 安装立即升级到其中某个版本。 GitLab.com 已经运行了修复后的版本。 运行 19.3.5-internal0 和 19.4.2-internal0 或更高版本的 GitLab Dedicated 租户已包含这些修复，无需采取任何操作。

sents.en: These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to one of these versions immediately.
sents.zh: 这些版本包含重要的错误修复和安全修复，我们强烈建议所有自管理的 GitLab 安装立即升级到其中某个版本。

sents.en: GitLab.com is already running the patched version.
sents.zh: GitLab.com 已经运行了修复后的版本。

sents.en: GitLab Dedicated tenants running 19.3.5-internal0 and 19.4.2-internal0 or later already include these fixes and do not need to take action.
sents.zh: 运行 19.3.5-internal0 和 19.4.2-internal0 或更高版本的 GitLab Dedicated 租户已包含这些修复，无需采取任何操作。

paragraphs.en: GitLab releases fixes for vulnerabilities in patch releases. There are two types of patch releases: scheduled releases and ad-hoc critical patches for high-severity vulnerabilities. Scheduled releases are released twice a month on the second and fourth Wednesdays. For more information, please visit our releases handbook and security FAQ . You can see all of GitLab release blog posts here .
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 在补丁版本中发布漏洞修复。 补丁版本有两种类型：按计划发布的版本，以及针对高危漏洞的临时关键补丁。 计划发布的版本每月发布两次，分别在第二个和第四个星期三。 有关更多信息，请访问我们的发布手册和安全常见问题解答。 你可以在这里查看 GitLab 的所有发布博客文章。

sents.en: GitLab releases fixes for vulnerabilities in patch releases.
sents.zh: GitLab 在补丁版本中发布漏洞修复。

sents.en: There are two types of patch releases: scheduled releases and ad-hoc critical patches for high-severity vulnerabilities.
sents.zh: 补丁版本有两种类型：按计划发布的版本，以及针对高危漏洞的临时关键补丁。

sents.en: Scheduled releases are released twice a month on the second and fourth Wednesdays.
sents.zh: 计划发布的版本每月发布两次，分别在第二个和第四个星期三。

sents.en: For more information, please visit our releases handbook and security FAQ .
sents.zh: 有关更多信息，请访问我们的发布手册和安全常见问题解答。

sents.en: You can see all of GitLab release blog posts here .
sents.zh: 你可以在这里查看 GitLab 的所有发布博客文章。

paragraphs.en: For security fixes, the issues detailing each vulnerability are made public on our issue tracker 90 days after the release in which they were patched.
paragraphs.zh: 针对安全修复，详细说明每个漏洞的问题会在包含修复补丁的版本发布 90 天后，在我们的议题追踪器上公开。

paragraphs.en: We are committed to ensuring that all aspects of GitLab that are exposed to customers or that host customer data are held to the highest security standards. To maintain good security hygiene, it is highly recommended that all customers upgrade to the latest patch release for their supported version. You can read more best practices in securing your GitLab instance in our blog post.
paragraphs.zh: 我们致力于确保 GitLab 中面向客户或托管客户数据的各个方面都符合最高的安全标准。 为了保持良好的安全卫生习惯，强烈建议所有客户将其受支持版本升级到最新的补丁版本。 您可以在我们的博客文章中阅读更多有关保护 GitLab 实例安全的最佳实践。

sents.en: We are committed to ensuring that all aspects of GitLab that are exposed to customers or that host customer data are held to the highest security standards.
sents.zh: 我们致力于确保 GitLab 中面向客户或托管客户数据的各个方面都符合最高的安全标准。

sents.en: To maintain good security hygiene, it is highly recommended that all customers upgrade to the latest patch release for their supported version.
sents.zh: 为了保持良好的安全卫生习惯，强烈建议所有客户将其受支持版本升级到最新的补丁版本。

sents.en: You can read more best practices in securing your GitLab instance in our blog post.
sents.zh: 您可以在我们的博客文章中阅读更多有关保护 GitLab 实例安全的最佳实践。

paragraphs.en: We strongly recommend that all installations running a version affected by the issues described below are upgraded to the latest version as soon as possible .
paragraphs.zh: 我们强烈建议所有受以下所述问题影响、正在运行相关版本的用户尽快升级到最新版本。

paragraphs.en: When no specific deployment type (omnibus, source code, helm chart, etc.) of a product is mentioned, it means all types are affected.
paragraphs.zh: 当未提及产品的特定部署类型（omnibus、源代码、helm chart 等）时，表示所有类型均受影响。

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server due to integer overflow when compiling a specially crafted regular expression.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：在某些条件下，由于编译特制正则表达式时发生整数溢出，未认证的用户可能因此在 GitLab 服务器上执行任意代码。

paragraphs.en: In addition to our standard patch releases, we have backported this fix to GitLab CE/EE versions 18.11.13, 19.0.10, 19.1.9, and 19.2.9.
paragraphs.zh: 除常规补丁版本外，我们已将此修复反向移植到 GitLab CE/EE 版本 18.11.13、19.0.10、19.1.9 和 19.2.9。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 7.0 before 18.11.13, 19.0 before 19.0.10, 19.1 before 19.1.9, 19.2 before 19.2.9, 19.3 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 10.0 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的版本：GitLab CE/EE：从 7.0 起低于 18.11.13、19.0 起低于 19.0.10、19.1 起低于 19.1.9、19.2 起低于 19.2.9、19.3 起低于 19.3.6、19.4 起低于 19.4.3，以及 19.5 起低于 19.5.1 的所有版本 CVSS 10.0 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H )

paragraphs.en: Thanks joaxcar for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 joaxcar 通过我们的 HackerOne 漏洞赏金计划报告此漏洞

paragraphs.en: GitLab security has released two threat detections to support customers with self-managed instances, listed below. GitLab-managed infrastructure, including GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated, remains patched.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 安全团队已发布两项威胁检测，以支持自管理实例的客户，如下所列。 GitLab 托管的基础设施（包括 GitLab.com 和 GitLab Dedicated）已完成修补。

sents.en: GitLab security has released two threat detections to support customers with self-managed instances, listed below.
sents.zh: GitLab 安全团队已发布两项威胁检测，以支持自管理实例的客户，如下所列。

sents.en: GitLab-managed infrastructure, including GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated, remains patched.
sents.zh: GitLab 托管的基础设施（包括 GitLab.com 和 GitLab Dedicated）已完成修补。

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, when OmniAuth SAML and LDAP auto-linking were both enabled, an authenticated user could have taken over an existing LDAP-backed account without any interaction from the targeted user, due to improper input sanitization in the LDAP email lookup path used during OmniAuth identity linking.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：当 OmniAuth SAML 和 LDAP 自动链接同时启用时，由于 OmniAuth 身份链接过程中使用的 LDAP 邮箱查询路径存在不当的输入清理问题，经过身份验证的智能体可能在目标用户毫无察觉的情况下接管现有的基于 LDAP 的账户。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 10.1 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 8.2 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab CE/EE：从 10.1 起且低于 19.3.6 的所有版本，19.4 起且低于 19.4.3 的所有版本，以及 19.5 起且低于 19.5.1 的所有版本 CVSS 8.2 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N )

paragraphs.en: Thanks stealthy for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 stealthy 通过我们的 HackerOne 漏洞赏金计划报告此漏洞。

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, an unauthenticated user could have poisoned a shared cache’s OAuth/OIDC discovery document to redirect certain flows to an externally controlled server, due to improper trust of user-supplied values when constructing endpoint URLs in cached discovery responses.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：在某些条件下，未经身份验证的用户可能污染共享缓存的 OAuth/OIDC 发现文档，将某些流程重定向到外部控制的服务器，原因是在构造缓存发现响应中的端点 URL 时，对用户提供的值信任不当。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 18.3 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 7.5 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:L )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的版本：GitLab CE/EE：18.3 的 19.3.6 之前所有版本、19.4 的 19.4.3 之前所有版本，以及 19.5 的 19.5.1 之前所有版本。CVSS 评分 7.5（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:L）

paragraphs.en: This vulnerability has been discovered internally by GitLab team member Peter Arts
paragraphs.zh: 此漏洞由 GitLab 团队成员 Peter Arts 在内部发现

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with a read_api-scoped token to retrieve a project’s incoming email address and create work items, bypassing the token’s restrictions, due to insufficient scope enforcement on a GraphQL field.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：由于对某个 GraphQL 字段的作用域限制不足，在特定条件下，持有 read_api 作用域令牌的已认证用户本可以获取项目的入站电子邮件地址并创建工作项，从而绕过该令牌的限制。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 18.2 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 6.8 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab CE/EE：18.2 的 19.3.6 之前所有版本、19.4 的 19.4.3 之前所有版本，以及 19.5 的 19.5.1 之前所有版本 CVSS 6.8 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N )

paragraphs.en: Thanks go7f0 for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 go7f0 通过我们的 HackerOne 漏洞赏金计划报告此漏洞

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, when the instance-wide SAML or LDAP membership lock was enabled, an authenticated user could have granted or accepted project and group membership outside the identity provider’s control, due to incomplete enforcement of the membership lock on requests created before the lock was enabled.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：当启用了实例级 SAML 或 LDAP 成员身份锁定时，由于在启用锁定之前创建的请求未完全执行成员身份锁定，经过身份验证的用户可能在身份提供商的控制之外授予或接受项目和群组成员身份。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 12.0 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 5.9 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab EE：12.0 起所有 19.3.6 之前的版本、19.4 起所有 19.4.3 之前的版本，以及 19.5 起所有 19.5.1 之前的版本。CVSS 5.9（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N）

paragraphs.en: Thanks 3nvz for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 3nvz 通过我们的 HackerOne 漏洞赏金计划报告此漏洞

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, an unauthenticated user could have retrieved sensitive internal server credentials due to improper filtering of internal response headers.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：在某些条件下，由于内部响应头过滤不当，未经身份验证的用户可能获取敏感的内部服务器凭据。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 17.6.5 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 4.3 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的版本：GitLab CE/EE：19.3.6 之前自 17.6.5 起的所有版本、19.4.3 之前的 19.4，以及 19.5.1 之前的 19.5 CVSS 4.3（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N）

paragraphs.en: Thanks altair00 for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 altair00 通过我们的 HackerOne 漏洞赏金计划报告此漏洞

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that could have allowed an authenticated user to read milestone metadata, including titles, descriptions, and full project paths, from arbitrary private projects across the instance without any project membership, due to missing authorization checks on a user-supplied project filter parameter in the group milestones API.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：由于群组里程碑 API 中对用户提供的项目筛选参数缺少授权检查，经过身份验证的用户原本可以在实例中跨任意私有项目读取里程碑元数据（包括标题、描述和完整项目路径），而无需任何项目成员资格。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 15.10 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 4.3 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab CE/EE：15.10 起 19.3.6 之前的所有版本、19.4 起 19.4.3 之前的所有版本，以及 19.5 起 19.5.1 之前的所有版本 CVSS 4.3 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N )

paragraphs.en: Thanks a0xnirudh for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 a0xnirudh 通过我们的 HackerOne 漏洞赏金计划报告此漏洞

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to access paid AI features without a valid subscription due to insufficient server-side validation in billing eligibility checks.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：在某些情况下，由于计费资格检查中的服务端验证不足，可能允许已认证的用户在没有有效订阅的情况下访问付费 AI 功能。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 17.8 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 4.3 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的版本：GitLab EE：19.3.6 之前的所有 17.8 版本、19.4.3 之前的所有 19.4 版本，以及 19.5.1 之前的所有 19.5 版本 CVSS 4.3（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N）

paragraphs.en: This vulnerability has been discovered internally by GitLab team member Halil Coban
paragraphs.zh: 该漏洞由 GitLab 团队成员 Halil Coban 内部发现。

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, when a merge request in a public project referenced a confidential issue from a private project, an authenticated user with no project membership could have read the confidential issue’s title, due to a viewer-independent fragment cache key that incorrectly shared per-user-redacted rendered content across all users.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：当公开项目中的合并请求引用了私有项目中的机密议题时，由于一个与查看者无关的片段缓存键错误地在所有用户之间共享了按用户脱敏后的渲染内容，未经项目成员资格认证的用户可能读取到该机密议题的标题。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 15.0 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 3.5 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab CE/EE：从 15.0 起至 19.3.6 之前的所有版本、19.4 起至 19.4.3 之前的所有版本，以及 19.5 起至 19.5.1 之前的所有版本 CVSS 3.5（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N）

paragraphs.en: Thanks 20kilograma for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 20kilograma 通过我们的 HackerOne 漏洞赏金计划报告此漏洞

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to bypass a required merge request approval policy on a protected branch due to improper access control during approval rule synchronization.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：由于审批规则同步期间的访问控制不当，在某些条件下可能允许已认证用户绕过受保护分支上要求的合并请求审批策略。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 17.4 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 3.1 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab EE：17.4 的 19.3.6 之前的所有版本、19.4 的 19.4.3 之前的所有版本，以及 19.5 的 19.5.1 之前的所有版本 CVSS 3.1 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N )

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with read-only permissions to permanently delete existing vulnerability records due to improper cleanup logic that failed to distinguish between pre-existing records from newly created ones during error handling.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：在某些条件下，由于清理逻辑不当，在错误处理过程中未能区分既有记录与新建记录，可能导致拥有只读权限的已认证用户永久删除现有漏洞记录。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 17.8 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 3.1 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab EE：19.3.6 之前的所有 17.8 版本、19.4.3 之前的所有 19.4 版本，以及 19.5.1 之前的所有 19.5 版本 CVSS 3.1（ CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N ）

paragraphs.en: This vulnerability has been discovered internally by GitLab team member Gregory Havenga
paragraphs.zh: 该漏洞由 GitLab 团队成员 Gregory Havenga 内部发现

paragraphs.en: GitLab has remediated an issue that, when an instance administrator locked a group’s Duo availability, an authenticated user with group Owner permissions could have re-enabled AI-backed data egress to a third-party service for that group and its descendant projects, due to insufficient granularity of the admin-lock enforcement controls.
paragraphs.zh: GitLab 已修复一个问题：当实例管理员锁定某个群组的 Duo 可用性时，由于管理员锁定执行控制机制的粒度不足，拥有群组 Owner 权限的已认证用户可能会为该群组及其子项目重新启用基于 AI 的数据外泄至第三方服务。

paragraphs.en: Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 19.2 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 CVSS 2.7 ( CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N )
paragraphs.zh: 受影响版本：GitLab EE：19.3.6 之前的所有 19.2 版本、19.4.3 之前的所有 19.4 版本，以及 19.5.1 之前的所有 19.5 版本 CVSS 2.7（CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N）

paragraphs.en: This patch includes database migrations that may impact your upgrade process.
paragraphs.zh: 此补丁包含可能影响您升级过程的数据库迁移。

paragraphs.zh: 以下版本包含在升级过程中运行的常规迁移：

paragraphs.zh: 以下版本包含可在升级后运行的部署后迁移：
